meta.descripcion: Diagnosis and rebuilding of Porsche engines in our dedicated facility, including measurements, scope-based quotes, and pickup service across Spain.

h1: Porsche engine rebuilding in our dedicated facility

secciones.titulo: From the 356 boxer to modern models—all handled in-house
parrafos: We restore, refurbish, and repair any engine from the brand—ranging from the 356's four-cylinder boxer to current models—in our own dedicated engine facility. This is the very heart of our business, a specialized setup that even official dealerships do not possess.
We collect engines from all over Spain. There is no need to bring the entire car; if the engine has already been removed, it can be shipped on its own.

imagenes.alt: The 968's engine block opened up, bores and bearings exposed

parrafos: Rebuilding a Porsche engine requires translating symptoms and signs into precise measurements before selecting parts or committing to a specific scope of work.

imagenes.alt: The 968's cylinder head with the camshafts fitted, on the bench

secciones.titulo: Engines covered and decisions made after measurement
parrafos: The dedicated workshop area handles air-cooled boxer engines, M96 and M97 units, racing engines, transaxle families, and modern engines based on the workshop's accumulated experience.

After disassembly, cleaning, and measurement, the available options are presented. Repairing only the visible fault may be insufficient, yet replacing everything without proper assessment is not a sound technical approach.

imagenes.alt: Finished 968 engine on its pallet, with the dual-mass flywheel and intake manifold fitted

secciones.titulo: Which engines do we work on?
items: Air-cooled flat-sixes, from the 356 to the 993.
M96 and M97 engines, including work on the IMS and addressing bore scoring.
Classic engines from other brands also make their way into the workshop.

parrafos: We don't open an engine just to replace a single part. We open it up, take precise measurements, and make decisions based on the data: clearances, ovality, cylinder head flatness, and the condition of the cylinder liners and crankshaft. The quote is generated from this information—never before.
We have our own machinery and tooling, as well as a dedicated parts-sourcing department—which accounts for half the work when dealing with forty-year-old engines.
The magazine showcases the work and photos in this documented case study.

secciones.titulo: What is delivered with the engine
parrafos: A detailed scope-of-work quote, a component log, and a fully assembled, tuned, and tested engine, built according to approved specifications.
Depending on the car's condition and intended use, the work can be coordinated with the engine shop, bore scoring repairs, and gearbox work.

secciones.titulo: Can you collect an engine from outside Barcelona or Madrid?
parrafos: Yes. The advertised service includes engine collection from anywhere in Spain and return delivery upon completion. The engine can be transported without the car if it has already been removed.

The definitive scope of work is determined after disassembly and measurement, particularly when internal damage is suspected. Beforehand, we explain the working hypotheses and the steps required to verify them.
